source.title: Blizzard Midnight hotfixes running list — March 13, 2026 entry
source.author: Blizzard Entertainment

quote: Newly created Crate of Battlefield Goods should now contain gear that disenchants into more relevant materials.
notes: March 13 hotfix applies only to equipment from NEWLY created Crate of Battlefield Goods, not to every Midnight drop, all gear at these levels, or Miststalker's Wristbands (272246). Official Blizzard running-list and Blizzard-mirror sources display levels 10–79 => The War Within and 80–90 => Midnight. Wowhead's same-day original hotfix transcription instead says 81–90 for Midnight, leaving an unresolved boundary discrepancy at level 80. The source gives no equipment item IDs, completed cast counts, material yields, quality, specialization or actual ilvl; do not use as a yield/probability sample. Primary text: https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/news/24266320 ; crosschecks https://www.mmo-champion.com/content/14101-WoW-Hotfixes-March-13-2026 and https://www.wowhead.com/news/midnight-hotfixes-for-march-13th-marl-decor-cost-reduction-class-bugfixes-and-380785
affects: Gear created from Crate of Battlefield Goods after the March 13, 2026 hotfix, separated by acquisition character level (10–79 vs 80–90 per current Blizzard running list); item IDs not supplied
wording: Newly created Crate of Battlefield Goods should now contain gear that disenchants into more relevant materials.
